svg.title: How stardelt fits together
svg.desc: Nova on top gives one interface and API. Below it the engines: Trino for SQL, Spark for compute, Kafka for streams, Airflow for pipelines, Jupyter for notebooks. All of them read and write the same Apache Iceberg tables. Everything runs on your Kubernetes, with your OIDC provider and your S3 storage.
svg.text: One sign-in, one interface, an API behind every screen
Open format, one REST catalog: every engine reads and writes the same data
Apache 2.0 · runs inside your perimeter · no phone-home
